@dataclass(frozen=True)
class _CardPolicy:
    stable_id: str
    operation: str
    minimum: int
    maximum: int
    commit_mode: str
    domain_minimum: int
    domain_maximum: int


# New rows require a separate evidence-bound caller selection. Public entry
# points cannot supply or extend this catalog.
_PRODUCTION_POLICIES = MappingProxyType({
    'cheese_gorge_add_two': _CardPolicy('ROOM_FULL_OF_CHEESE.pages.INITIAL.options.GORGE',
        'add', 2, 2, 'auto_at_max', 8, 8),
    'aroma_maintain_control_upgrade_one': _CardPolicy(
        'AROMA_OF_CHAOS.pages.INITIAL.options.MAINTAIN_CONTROL',
        'upgrade', 1, 1, 'preview_confirm', 2, 64),
    'sapphire_eat_upgrade_one': _CardPolicy(
        'SAPPHIRE_SEED.pages.INITIAL.options.EAT',
        'upgrade', 1, 1, 'preview_confirm', 2, 64),
})


def _catalog_copy(policies: Mapping[str, _CardPolicy]) -> Mapping[str, _CardPolicy]:
    _require(len(policies) <= 512)
    result = dict(policies)
    keys = set()
    for name, p in result.items():
        _require(type(name) is str and 1 <= len(name) <= 64 and
                 all('a' <= c <= 'z' or '0' <= c <= '9' or c == '_' for c in name) and
                 name not in ('item_reward', 'unsupported_card') and type(p) is _CardPolicy)
        _require(type(p.stable_id) is str and 1 <= len(p.stable_id) <= 96 and
                 all(' ' <= c <= '~' for c in p.stable_id) and p.stable_id not in keys)
        keys.add(p.stable_id)
        _require(p.operation in ('add', 'remove', 'upgrade', 'transform') and
                 p.commit_mode in ('auto_at_max', 'explicit_confirm', 'preview_confirm') and
                 all(type(x) is int for x in (p.minimum, p.maximum, p.domain_minimum, p.domain_maximum)) and
                 1 <= p.minimum <= p.maximum <= 8 and p.maximum <= p.domain_minimum <= p.domain_maximum <= 64)
    return MappingProxyType(result)
